name: NYC DOB NOW: Build approved permits
publisher: NYC Department of Buildings (NYC Open Data)

traps.check: One job can have many permits (one per work type). Count jobs (job_filing_number) if you mean projects.
A permit is permission, not completion. Use certificates of occupancy for finished buildings.
Only filings in DOB NOW (since 2016, nearly all since 2021). Older work is in the legacy permit dataset.
Coordinates are geocoded to the street frontage, so many points sit just outside their lot. Match lots with polygon_match = nearest (about 30 m), or by BBL.
